## Reply: `cleanup`

`cleanup` is not a verb on this menu, so I refused it and ran no command. Nothing was posted, closed, or released. Two reasons:

- **The PR is closed and not merged.** `mergeCommit` is null. The overrides' `## cleanup` close-ticket command would post "Delivered in https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/210, merged <merge-sha>." to acme/widgets#45. No merge SHA exists, so that comment would be false. Running `/skill:release` on unmerged code would also be wrong.
- **`## cleanup` is not this skill's section.** This gate leaves post-merge delivery to `/skill:check-delivery`. The only cleanup it owns is teardown, which runs on `stop`.

What `stop` does here: this run created the worktree `.worktrees/pr-210` (branch `csv-export`). It is tracked-clean and has no unpushed fix commits, so nothing would be lost. Under the Non-merge stop rule, teardown is offered on `stop` but never done without your consent. The untracked `node_modules/` would go with it. The continuation record, helper output files, and logs are deleted on exit either way.
